entry.title: My Journey Through the 5-Day AI Agents Intensive Course
entry.summary:
Participating in the Google AI Agents Intensive Course was an incredible learning experience that helped me understand AI agents, workflows, prompting, and practical applications. Throughout five days, I learned step-by-step how AI agents work and how they can solve real-world problems. On the first day, I learned what AI agents are, how they work, and where they are used. I also understood the importance of structured prompting and how an agent can think, plan, and execute tasks. This day focused on creating agents that can return structured data in a proper format. I learned to give good instructions using System Prompts and how to control the behavior of the AI. This helped me understand how agents follow rules and provide clean responses. Here, I learned how to connect AI agents with tools like calculators, search, or custom functions. It showed me how AI can interact with external actions and complete complex tasks in multiple steps. This day built my confidence in building practical agents. This was one of the most exciting days. I learned how to create my own custom GPT, modify its behavior, upload files, set rules, and publish it. This helped me understand how powerful and customizable AI agents can be. On the final day, I built a complete agent workflow combining tools, prompts, and structured outputs. I understood how to make an agent think step-by-step, use tools when needed, and produce final results. This day completed my learning journey. This 5-Day AI Agents Intensive Course improved my understanding of AI, automation, and smart workflows. It helped me build real AI agents, understand tools, create GPTs, and publish my work confidently.
It was a great journey that boosted my skills in AI and problem-solving.This is a submission for the Google AI Agents Writing Challenge: Learning Reflections
